text: 继今年6月上海脑机接口企业——博睿康冲刺科创板获上交所受理后，时隔3个月，上海另一家脑机接口公司也启动了科创板IPO辅导。从术理创新（上海）智能科技股份有限公司获悉，9月4日，术理创新正式启动科创板上市辅导。证监会官网IPO辅导公示系统显示，术理创新于2026年9月4日在上海证监局办理辅导备案登记，正式启动科创板IPO进程，华泰联合证券担任术理创新本次上市的辅导机构。（上证报）
text_en: Following BrainCo's STAR Market filing acceptance by the Shanghai Stock Exchange in June this year, another Shanghai brain-computer interface company has initiated STAR Market IPO guidance three months later. Shuli Innovation (Shanghai) Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. confirmed that it formally launched STAR Market listing guidance on September 4. The CSRC IPO guidance disclosure system shows Shuli Innovation filed guidance registration with the Shanghai Securities Regulatory Bureau on September 4, 2026, formally commencing its STAR Market IPO process, with Huatai United Securities serving as the guidance institution. (Shanghai Securities News)
